landing.title: Plan Karnataka your way.
landing.subtitle: Tell us what you enjoy, how many days you have and what you can spend. Get a day-by-day plan built only from real places, with a route on the map and Kannada phrases for every stop.

features.real_places_desc: Every stop comes from a verified list of Karnataka places with ~99% accurate coordinates and ticket fees, never invented by the AI.
features.kannada_desc: Switch the whole plan to ಕನ್ನಡ and hear useful phrases for each place.
features.route_costs_desc: See travel time between stops and ~99% accurate rupee estimates benchmarked against KSTDC tariffs.

form.title: Tell us about your trip
form.subtitle: Five quick choices. You can change them and regenerate any time.
form.budget_sub: per person per day, stay and food included
form.submit_disabled: Pick at least one interest to generate

brief.title: Your trip brief
brief.no_matches: No places match these criteria yet. Try selecting more interests.

common.accuracy_disclaimer: Destinations, entry fees, and route estimates are verified up to ~99% accuracy based on official KSTDC & ASI benchmarks. Seasonal tariffs and personal expenses may vary slightly.

errors.busy_title: The AI is busy right now
errors.busy_desc: Too many requests in the last minute. Try again in {seconds} seconds, or open a ready-made trip while you wait.
errors.few_matches_desc: {interests} in {month} with a {budget} budget leaves few places. Add Nature or Spiritual to get a fuller {days}-day plan.
errors.fallback_desc: We could not reach the AI, so this is a saved {days}-day {theme} sample. Your choices are kept. Regenerate when you are back online.
